$comment: Boundary fixtures for versioned BPPU/KOP codes (Task 5). BPPU codes are first-class versioned reporting metadata — never rate authority. The codes carry their own validity interval and source, and they tag rules for reporting only. The 24-104-0x family became canonical in the eBupot unifikasi era (KEP-143/PJ/2022 + PER-24/PJ/2021, effective 21 Februari 2022), then transitioned to BPPU/Coretax under PER-11/PJ/2025 effective 1 Maret 2025. The underlying PPh 23 rates long predate those codes (UU 36/2008 + PMK 141/2015).

versioningBoundaries.description: KOP/BPPU 24-104-02 'Jasa Manajemen' is the current reporting code (KEP-143/PJ/2022 + PER-24/PJ/2021, effective 21 Februari 2022). It is referenced by rule-pph-23-jasa-manajemen-with-npwp purely as reporting metadata; the rate itself comes from UU PPh Pasal 23(1)(c)(2).
KOP/BPPU 24-104-03 'Jasa Konsultan' is the current reporting code referenced by the jasa konsultan rules (the goal scenario).
KOP/BPPU 24-104-01 'Jasa Teknik' is referenced by the jasa teknik rules.
KOP 24-100-02 'Sewa/perolehan lain atas harta selain tanah/bangunan' tags the PPh 23 movable-rent rule.

BPPU 28-403-02 'Persewaan Tanah dan/atau Bangunan' is FINAL PPh 4(2) 10% — used by the PPh 23 scope-exclusion marker rule. It is NOT PPh 23; it is referenced only to make the scope exclusion discoverable.

nonAuthority: BPPU codes are reporting metadata. The PPh 23 rate is sourced from UU PPh Pasal 23(1)(c)(2) and PMK 141/2015, never from the BPPU code itself.
A rule's bppuId is a stable reporting reference; changing the BPPU code does not change the rate.
BPPU codes have their own validity interval and source registry entries independent of the rate rules.
